verdict.line: You lose if Aatrox hits three W (Infernal Chains) sweetspots before level 4 and snowballs the healing; you win if you survive to level 6-7 and force all-ins where your E (Apprehend) traps him before he can dash out.

brief.thesis: Aatrox's Q (The Darkin Blade) resets and W (Infernal Chains) pull make him the aggressor in every trade from level 1-5, and his R (World Ender) heal punishes extended fights before you have the HP pool to out-damage lifesteal. Darius flips the matchup once he hits level 6, because Apprehend pulls Aatrox out of his Q3 dash windows and Noxian Guillotine (R) execute damage scales faster than Aatrox's sustain past 20 stacks of bleed.

theirWindow.when: Levels 1-5, W chain lands or Q3 up
theirWindow.what: He will chain W into full auto-Q3 combo for 40%+ of your HP; do not contest CS in melee range if his W is off cooldown, back off to max range and let minions trade for you.

yourWindow.when: Level 6+, his W and dash both down
yourWindow.what: Walk up and force the fight immediately — land E (Apprehend) to pull him in, stack five Hemorrhage bleeds, and burst with R (Noxian Guillotine) before he can reset the trade with a second Q cast.

powerCurve.note: W chain punishes any CS attempt in melee
Q resets and passive heal win extended trades
your R execute threat offsets his R sustain
five-stack bleed plus E lockdown wins all-ins
item HP and armor outscale his fading Q healing

start.why: Negates his poke and passive Q healing chip damage so you survive to level 6 without back trips

boots.why: Reduces sustained auto and Q3 damage from his auto-attack-reliant combo

core.why: Slow on hit keeps him inside E range so he can't kite the Q3 dash back after engage
Proc healing on crit trades directly against his passive lifesteal in extended fights
Grievous Wounds cut guts his Q passive heal and R heal, the two things that let him win late trades

situational.when: he rushes goredrinker-style lifesteal and you need grievous wounds earlier than core order
he is fed and threatening to one-shot you through R (World Ender)
you are ahead and want to remove his burst window entirely while still dealing damage

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks during the extended trades this matchup forces and converts to healing that offsets his lifesteal once level 6+ fights start

summoners.why: Ghost lets you stick through his Q3 dash-away instead of losing the follow-up after E lands

playing.title: Track his W cooldown all lane
playing.detail: Infernal Chains is roughly 10-12 seconds early; step up for CS only in the window right after he uses it on a minion or misses it on you.

playing.title: Never fight into full resolve stacks
playing.detail: His passive damage-into-heal stacks reset on kill or takedown; if he is topped off on that passive, disengage rather than trade.

playing.title: Save E for his dash, not the engage
playing.detail: Apprehend should punish his Q3 dash-out attempt, pulling him back into your Hemorrhage stacks instead of leading with it.

playing.title: Freeze before level 6
playing.detail: Play a slow-push-into-freeze near your tower from levels 2-5 to deny him easy chain-into-auto trades on a neutral wave.

playing.title: All-in only at five stacks
playing.detail: Hemorrhage's max stack armor shred is what lets your R execute through his R sustain; don't guillotine early off three stacks.

playing.title: Respect his R timer, not just cooldown
playing.detail: World Ender's healing-per-hit falls off after roughly 10 seconds; if the fight is close, disengage and re-engage once his ultimate duration expires.

playing.title: Ban-adjacent pick priority
playing.detail: If he gets a kill before level 6, consider playing for scaling side waves rather than forcing more trades, since his snowball compounds faster than yours pre-6.

brief.patchCaveat: Item and rune names reflect the standard 25.x-era Darius top build; verify Stridebreaker, Sundered Sky, and Conqueror numbers haven't been reworked on the current patch before locking runes.
